name: Rezin
overview: Rezin was a male member of the tribe of Levi who served as a temple servant. His role as a temple servant highlights his involvement in the religious life and worship practices central to Israel's covenant community. There are no additional notes recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Rezin appears as a proper name in Scripture without a given meaning or divine origin indicated. It is simply recorded as the personal name of this individual.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture identifies Rezin as a descendant of Levi, linking him to the priestly tribe responsible for temple service. Beyond this tribal affiliation, no further family relationships are documented.
scriptureSignificance: Rezin's significance lies in his role as a temple servant from the tribe of Levi, underscoring the continuity of Levitical duties in the post-exilic community. His mention reflects the restoration of temple worship and the reestablishment of the Levitical order following Israel's return from exile. Though details are minimal, his inclusion in the biblical record affirms the faithfulness of God's people in maintaining their sacred responsibilities.
